notes: B1 redrawn 2026-08-30 after founder review: 26 panels covering every control, not just the happy path. Search, filters, date picker, groups, offer builder, empty states, sticky buttons, status chips.
scope: Only the Campaigns tab of the brand app. The Creators tab is B2, the creator's side is B5, admin is B8.
the_rule: A set is one aim, one posting date, one shoot mode. Everything else is per creator. Posting date >= today + 7; invitations close 3 days before; a store visit finishes 1 day before.
new_screens: Her terms — one screen carrying commission/money, deliverables, what she can sell, her offer and her channels. Replaces the entire second brief.
She countered the money — she stays in the set.
She countered the date or the mode — accept and move her to a matching set, or decline. THE RISKIEST SCREEN IN B1: nothing in the app has ever moved a row between sets.
heaviest_change: Set wizard step 2 (Basics). Gains the shoot mode and one posting date; loses the two-field posting window, the channels and the deliverables — the last two move to each creator.
decisions_owed: Does 'by filter' get a screen now? It exists in the database and has never had one, so only two of the three invite routes actually work.
When she is moved to a matching set, does she re-confirm? Recommendation: NO — she lands on the exact terms she asked for, so asking again would be the double-ask this architecture removes.

release.deploy_class: deploy-inert — mockups and specification only, no code

founder_caught_me_on: add your FIRST set vs add ANOTHER set
the filter picker and what is in it
offer: pick existing vs build new, and what build-new contains
the_filter: Five, per the founder: State (India, state-wise, searchable chips) · Language · Niche · Follower tier (nano/micro/mid/macro/mega) · Engagement rate (four coarse bands). All five are backed by real columns on influencers.
deferral_flow_corrected: The founder replaced my design. Mine: pick an existing matching set. His: she leaves the set, the brand chooses DISAGREE (it ends) or MOVE HER OUT (she waits in a deferred pool), and later a NEW SET IS BUILT FROM the deferred, grouped by date + mode. No matching set has to exist first. Building one opens the wizard at step 2 with the date, mode and creators pre-filled.
data_warnings: influencers.language is EMPTY on all 25 rows — the filter will match nobody until creators can set it, which is a B7 profile change.
Engagement rate was deliberately REMOVED from creator search once, with a written reason. The founder wants it back; drawn as four coarse bands rather than a number box.
offer_builder_already_exists: Checked at the founder's instruction. CreatorOfferSheet + offerBuilders.js already ship five types on the phone — Discount, Volume, BOGO, Bundle, Free gift — with library-or-new-or-none, scope (store/category/products), a validity window and a shopper preview. No pre-book on mobile. Documented, not invented.
